Settings

Raw access: whoever it is shared with can mount all of it. User storage: whoever it is shared with keeps folders of their own in it, and sees nothing else. Switching to user storage keeps existing mounts where they are, as each user's storage.

In-memory volumes have no settings. Their data is lost when the server stops.
